# Checking message for a card Claude built (D-200)

The planner fills in the card ID (or the batch's cards) and the builder's folder, and starts a **separate Claude checking session** with this message when the builder session has finished. The checking session neither planned nor built the card. It checks and replies PASS or FAIL; it never fixes, commits, merges or pushes. On PASS the planner merges the card into `main`, runs the full check there and shows the card running (D-195).

```
You are the checker for task card TASK-XXXX in the YTP Nexus project. A separate Claude building session built it in its own copy: the git worktree C:/Users/Spartan/Documents/pranav/ytp/ytp-work/TASK-XXXX (branch task/TASK-XXXX). The main folder is C:/Users/Spartan/Documents/pranav/ytp/YTP-SAAS (branch main). You did not plan or build this card, and you never fix anything: you only compare the finished work with its card and reply PASS or FAIL (AGENTS.md section 1).
Read AGENTS.md completely, the card docs/tasks/TASK-XXXX.md and the documents its BEFORE YOU START names, docs/templates/CARD-PROMPT.md (the builder's message) and docs/templates/TASK-LOG.md. Then check, in the builder's copy:
1. The commits: `git log --format='%h %s' <start point>..HEAD` (the start point is the first `- Start point (commit):` line of docs/logs/TASK-XXXX.md) shows only commits named for the card, the first with WHEN GREEN's exact text; `git status --porcelain` is empty; `git diff --name-only <start point>..HEAD` lists only the card's ALLOWED FILES plus its log, its evidence folder and its lines in docs/STATUS.md and docs/tasks/INDEX.md.
2. The code: every file matches the card's STEPS (word for word where the card gives the code), with nothing added, renamed or improved; no byte-order mark; no secret anywhere.
3. The test lock: from the main folder, `python tools/tasks/check-lock.py C:/Users/Spartan/Documents/pranav/ytp/ytp-work/TASK-XXXX` must print `problems: 0` and no test file touched.
4. The check: first make sure nothing listens on port 3000 or 5310 (PowerShell: `Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object LocalPort -In 3000,5310 | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess` prints nothing); if a port is busy, wait and look again every 2 minutes (another session's check may be running; only one check runs at a time), and never stop a process you did not start. Start Docker Desktop if needed and run `pnpm services:up` (never `pnpm services:down`). Then run `pnpm verify --card TASK-XXXX` in the builder's copy: it must end `verify: PASSED`, with no `api could not start` and no `EADDRINUSE`.
5. The record: the log follows the template and the builder's message (one bare start-point line written first, the other fields filled only after their runs, both start-check outputs and the final run pasted whole, every command listed exactly as typed and in order, the evidence save command exactly one of the template's two lines, no verify after the evidence run, Done set only after the final verify, Notes for next task correct). Compare it with the building session's own record: the newest .jsonl file in C:/Users/Spartan/.claude/projects/C--Users-Spartan-Documents-pranav-ytp-ytp-work-TASK-XXXX/ (read it; never edit it). Check that the builder stopped no process it did not start, touched nothing outside its copy and pushed nothing.
6. For a card in the careful lane (docs/tasks/LANES.md): try to break it. In a throwaway clone of the builder's branch in your own folder C:/Users/Spartan/Documents/pranav/ytp/ytp-review/check-XXXX/ (git clone --shared; copy infra/.env.test from the builder's copy without printing it), plant at least five small mistakes in the card's code, one at a time, and run the card's own test files: each mistake must make a test fail. A mistake no test catches is a FAIL finding for the planner (a plan gap), not the builder's fault.
Rules: never edit, commit, merge or push in the main folder or the builder's copy; never print infra/.env or infra/.env.test or any password; never touch the containers or volumes of ytp-nexus-dev other than through `pnpm services:up`, the pgadmin containers or ytp-proto-pg; work only in your own folder and delete it at the end.
Write your full report to C:/Users/Spartan/Documents/pranav/ytp/ytp-review/checks/TASK-XXXX.md (what you checked, with the commands and their results, and each finding as "builder slip" or "plan gap", with the file and line). Then reply with exactly: first line `TASK-XXXX: PASS` or `TASK-XXXX: FAIL`, then at most five short lines: the check result, each finding that sends the card back, and the report's path.
```
